reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative:
The project is a one day activity (summit). The activity is a conference to which will be held in Lilongwe and the embassy has agreed to grant financial support. This is the fifth time the conference is held. The summit is part of celebrating this year’s International Women’s Day on 8 March 2025 under the theme ‘Accelerate Action’
The summit aims at increasing awareness and advocacy for education in Malawi, empowering women, establishing new partnerships and collaborations to support education initiatives. This event will feature a line-up of speakers from the education, corporate business, entrepreneurship, creative arts, sports, student and civil society sectors among others. The First lady of Republic of Malawi, and the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education are among the high-level invited guests. In particular, the Royal Norwegian Ambassador to Malawi has been requested to be one of the keynote speakers at the event.
The outcomes of the conference are: 1.To promote education as a key driver of economic empowerment and development. 2. To provide a platform for women leaders to address education disparities, share their experiences and expertise on how we can improve the public education space in Malawi. 3. To raise awareness and support towards education initiatives in Malawi. 4. Foster an inclusive network, a platform for women to connect, build relationships, collaboration and mentorship. 5. Drive organizational change though through exploring ways to influence organizational, community policies, culture and practices that enable women to thrive in leadership positions. 6. Launch Evolve, a youth program focusing on youth empowerment and education. 7. Celebrate 100 Inspiring Women in Malawi Season III.
